name: validate — structural dag.json validation
description: Reads a plan dag.json via the JSON-file serializer and runs @adhd/dispatch-base-spec's validateDagJson over it. Returns { valid, errors } with error path/message on failure; returns { valid: true, errors: [] } on success. Read-only — never mutates the dag.
signature_note: Delegates to @adhd/dispatch-base-spec's validateDagJson; the core.ts wrapper catches 'file not found' (returns structured error, never throws) — tested at both the DI'd core level and the spawned CLI child process.

name: snapshot — compute fresh DagSnapshot
description: Loads a dag.json via real DagClient, then computes a DagSnapshot via @adhd/dispatch-core-optimizer's snapshot() using cold-start B/context-window defaults (no calibration file consulted). Derives per-milestone status, eligibility, and estimated/actual tokens. Read-only.

signature_note: Read-only pipeline: DagClient.load() -> computeSnapshot(); B and context-window defaults imported from @adhd/dispatch-orchestrator's own constants (never duplicated). guardDagExists() throws early if dag file is missing.

name: optimize — compute next DispatchUnit batch
description: Computes the next batch of DispatchUnits the greedy optimizer would pack right now: snapshot() followed by optimize(). Read-only — does not dispatch anything. Returns an array of DispatchUnit objects with compiled prompts.

name: run — one orchestrator scheduling cycle
description: Runs exactly one @adhd/dispatch-orchestrator scheduling cycle against a dag.json: snapshot -> optimize -> dispatch every returned unit -> persist (one dispatch_log entry appended per dispatched unit). dryRun parameter (default true) selects the execution backend: true = MockAgentRunner (no network, no cost); false = real AgentMcpRunner (paid boundary, spawns npx -y @adhd/agent-mcp). The hand-written bin/cli.ts supports --no-dry-run negation.

Default path uses dispatch-cli's own tmp namespace (DEFAULT_RUN_DEBUG_DIR). --no-dry-run threads dryRun:false through Commander's native negation flag — a capability the apigen-generated CLI cannot express (presence-only boolean flags). name: calibrate — measure baseline per-tier token cost
description: Fires a trivial 'null task' prompt against a real AgentMcpRunner (npx -y @adhd/agent-mcp) to measure a baseline per-tier token cost ('B'), then merges the measurement into ~/.adhd/dispatch-calibration.json (keyed by model tier, preserving other recorded tiers). PAID BOUNDARY — every call fires one real, billed model call. Not exercised by default-running tests, which call calibrateCore with MockAgentRunner and a tmp path.
